# ANKI CARDS (aiankipro.com)

> AI-powered flashcard app for creating, studying, and reviewing Markdown cards with per-card tutor chat.

Canonical site: https://aiankipro.com

## Public Pages

- Home: https://aiankipro.com/
- About: https://aiankipro.com/about
- Pricing: https://aiankipro.com/pricing
- Contact: https://aiankipro.com/contact

## Legal

- Terms: https://aiankipro.com/terms
- Privacy: https://aiankipro.com/privacy
- Refund Policy: https://aiankipro.com/refund-policy

## Product Summary

- Users can sign in and create decks/cards.
- Cards support Markdown and Mermaid diagrams.
- Study mode supports spaced repetition and review tracking.
- AI generation can create cards from a topic.
- AI tutor chat can explain individual cards and produce study summaries.

## Crawling Notes

- Public marketing and legal pages are indexable.
- Authenticated app areas are behind sign-in and should not be indexed.
